response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it has the most consistent support from the vignette, including systolic apical ballooning and ST-segment elevation with normal coronary arteries, which are characteristic of Takotsubo cardiomyopathy. R5 is the runner-up because it has some supporting evidence, such as the adrenal mass, but it is less consistent with the overall clinical presentation.
